episodes.text: 2026-04-30: Riya Malhotra wants to cut the bulk-payout CSV export and the payout nickname feature at sprint planning on 11 May; she always pairs with Aisha Rahman on scope cuts before sprint planning, brings Wen Li's data, and Aisha pushes back on any cut lacking numbers.

2026-04-30: Wen Li's 90-day Looker Payouts Explore pull (email 18f2c91a, 28 Apr): bulk payout CSV export used by 31 of 2,140 active merchants (1.4%), 70% of those are 3 accounts; payout nicknames set by 212 merchants (9.9%), only 18 edited after setup; scheduled payouts 1,064 merchants (49.7%). Definitions on the 'metric defs' tab.

2026-04-30: Assistant booked calendar event evt_7d21ac 'Scope cuts: payouts sprint (Riya / Aisha)' on Fri 1 May 2026 12:00-12:25 (America/Toronto) with Aisha Rahman, agenda and Wen's numbers attached. Assistant judged CSV export a strong cut case and nicknames weaker.
2026-04-30: Linear digest: PAY-1412 retry window config moved to In Review (Aisha); PAY-1398 payout status webhook docs blocked on copy review (Diego); 2 new P3 beta-payouts bugs.

2026-05-08: Renovation demo crew started; the Malhotra/Okafor family is on a temporary basement kitchen (microwave, induction hotplate, old fridge). Assistant suggested 5 dinners (black bean tacos, microwave baked potatoes with chili, egg fried rice, pesto pasta, rotisserie chicken with salad and corn) and saved a shopping list in notes 'Dinners wk of 11 May', about $74; aluminium pot won't work on induction, use the cast iron.

2026-05-08: Vancouver flights confirmed: Air Canada booking ref QX7L2P (email 19a07be3), 3 passengers (Riya Malhotra, Sam Okafor, Leo Okafor), AC117 Toronto-Vancouver Thu 2026-07-09 08:00-10:05, return AC120 Mon 2026-07-13 13:15-20:55, Economy Standard, seats 23C/23D/23E, total $1,947.66 CAD.

2026-05-08: Mei (Riya's relative in Kitsilano, Vancouver) emailed that Ira's naming ceremony is at their place on Saturday 2026-07-11; Kabir plans a barbecue; Leo gets the pull-out in Ira's room. Trip moved from the August long weekend to 9-13 July. Assistant added all-day calendar event evt_81fe03 'Vancouver trip' (9-13 Jul) with Sam.

2026-05-09: Leslieville BIA May newsletter summary for Riya: Queen St E watermain replacement between Leslie St and Jones Ave from Tue 19 May for about 9 weeks (weekdays 7am-7pm, eastbound lane restrictions, 501 streetcar delays, relocated stops); Green P at Coxwell & Queen closes 1-14 Jun (street permit unaffected); Leslieville Flea at Ashbridge Estate Sun 24 May, 28 Jun, 26 Jul; new repair shop Northbound Cycle at 1311 Queen E.

2026-05-09: Riya picked the name :zoom-money: for the custom Slack emoji (money bag with speed lines) Diego Fernandez is making for the payouts team; assistant agreed and offered backups (:instant-cash:, :payout-dash:, etc.). Diego posted 3 drafts in #design-crit. Aisha shared beta runbook v4 in Notion.

2026-05-11: Riya accepted Hannah Cho's offer for Leo to sleep over at the Chos' (Jun is begging); Hannah picks up both boys at 15:30 for pizza and a movie and walks them in Tue 12 May morning. Assistant texted Hannah a yes, said Riya would drop Leo's bag at lunch, and added family calendar event evt_92ab4e (Mon 11 May 15:30 to Tue 12 May 08:30). Offered a packing list (not confirmed).
2026-05-11: Ottawa drive check for Fri 15 May long weekend: leaving 06:00 about 4h40m, leaving 15:00 about 6h25m; leaving before 07:00 recommended.

2026-05-12: Payouts beta review at 13:00-14:00, Room 4B King St W + Zoom; doc agenda: beta health (Wen), incidents and retries (Aisha), merchant feedback themes (Riya, 15 min), GA readiness checklist; pre-read Looker 'Instant Payouts Beta' dashboard and 8 merchant interview notes.

2026-05-12: Open beta-payouts Linear bugs (5): PAY-1431 P2 duplicate webhook after 502 retry (Aisha, In Progress); PAY-1416 P2 credit union payout rejected on transit number (Aisha, In Progress); PAY-1427 P3 stale 'pending' status (Jonah Park, Todo); PAY-1424 P3 CSV history missing timezone column (unassigned, Triage); PAY-1419 P3 email typo 'recieved' (Diego, In Review). Ask for the room: an owner for PAY-1424.
2026-05-12: Wen Li updated the Looker Instant Payouts Beta dashboard at 12:41, excluding 2 test merchants from the success-rate calculation; Tom Becker and Aisha viewing the review.

2026-05-12: Found 'Q2 Roadmap Review - Product' deck (owner Tom Becker, edited Fri 8 May, docs.example.com/d/q2rr-prod): 27 comments, 19 open. Five need Riya: slide 6 trend line (Tom) and checklist link to v4 (Aisha); slide 8 April funnel screenshot (Diego); slide 11 Wen asks source of FX number; slide 13 typo. Riya asked for shorter replies on her phone.

2026-05-12: Daycare ideas for Diego's partner (1-year-old, Roncesvalles): OneList application, licensed home agencies (Wee Watch, Today's Family), Roncy Kids Co-op infant room (9-14 month wait), High Park Montessori toddler room Sept 2026; $10/day program with fees capped around $22/day, ask if each centre is enrolled.

2026-05-12: Riya posted in #payouts-launch the reminder that the beta retro is Thu 14 May 14:00 in Room 4B with Miro stickies (went well, didn't, try next). RSVPs: 9 yes, Olivia tentative (joins 20 min), Jonah confirmed; Diego asks to timebox to 45 min; 14 stickies, top theme webhook retries.

2026-05-12: Pricing table for $100 / $1,000 payment: Starter 2.9%+30c = $3.20 / $29.30; Growth 2.6%+25c = $2.85 / $26.25; Scale 2.2%+20c = $2.40 / $22.20; Enterprise custom. Matches public pricing page; Scale adds volume discounts from $250k/month.

2026-05-12: Drafted Riya's out-of-office for Fri 22 May, back Mon 25 May, Aisha Rahman covering payouts questions. Calendar check for 22 May found one real conflict: Fernwood Coffee check-in at 11:00; Thu 21 May 11:00 works for both; assistant offered to propose it (unanswered).
2026-05-14: Evening digest: Leo has school photo day Fri 15 May (blue shirt); Sam Okafor picked up tile sample from Nate (in hallway); Kabir Malhotra sent photo of Ira rolling over.

2026-05-14: Riya decided to drop same-day CAD-USD settlement from Instant Payouts v1 (moved to v1.1) to protect the launch date; reasons: FX partner certification won't land in time, and the 40 beta merchants mostly settle CAD only. Assistant added a row dated 2026-05-14 to the Instant Payouts PRD decision log in Notion (owner Riya); Aisha is watching the page.

2026-05-14: Open thread: PAY-1390 'Same-day CAD-USD settlement' (Jonah Park) still in Sprint 21; assistant offered to move it to the v1.1 backlog and to post a heads-up in #payouts-launch (no answer yet).

2026-05-16: Tom Becker DM'd Riya Saturday 18:04 asking why the beta success rate dipped Thursday ('not urgent'); Riya upset. Assistant guessed the dip is the 2 test merchants Wen removed Tuesday and offered to check.

2026-05-16: Money/inbox: Northline Renovations invoice #NR-2219, $6,400.00 (progress payment 3), due Fri 22 May, TD joint chequing covers it. Weekly spend 9-15 May: groceries $212.40, dining $64.10, kids $48.00, transit $35.00. Indigo order of 2 books arrives Tuesday.

2026-05-16: Email triage: replies needed to Morse Street PS (Grade 2 ROM trip permission form needs signature), Jonah Park (PAY-1424 ownership), Olivia Grant (Instant Payouts blurb), Ana Ruiz of Fernwood Coffee (bakery owner intro for beta). Drafts dr_771 (Jonah takes PAY-1424) and dr_772 (Ana) ready, not sent. Unsubscribed from 9 promo senders; Air Miles and Best Buy need login.
2026-05-16: Fernwood Coffee check-in moved from Fri 22 to Tue 19 May 13:00-13:25, clashes with Aisha's GA readiness sync 13:00-13:50; suggested moving Fernwood to 14:00.

2026-05-16: Riya texted Hannah Cho (sent 21:02) inviting her with Ellie and Jun to Riverdale Park East playground and market Sun 17 May 10:30; Hannah replied yes, meet by the big slide. Assistant to nudge at 10:00. Also helped fix Sam's Nest thermostat 4am setpoint (delete setpoint, turn off Auto-Schedule).
2026-05-16: Drafted blurb for Olivia Grant's Monday QBR sales deck on Instant Payouts v1; her slide 9 allows 40 words, 3 bullets, no roadmap dates, so blurb needs trimming before sending.

Findings: Northbound Cycle on Queen E open 11:00-16:00, chain repair about $15; tomatoes safe to plant; recycling pickup moves to Fri 22 May, flatten reno boxes to bundles max 75x75x20 cm.

Saved in notes 'Winterlude Saturday idea'; placeholder to calendar once 2027 dates are out.

2026-05-18: Riya wants to cut payout nicknames (PAY-1440 bulk edit, 3 pts) and scheduled-payouts calendar view (PAY-1442, 8 pts, carried over twice, no customer commitment) before sprint planning Mon 25 May, freeing 11 points; wants it sorted with Aisha by Thursday 21 May. Aisha's Wed 14:00 slot vanished; free Wed 20 May 10:30 or Thu 21 May 09:30. Invite not yet sent; one-pager in Notion 'Cycle 22 cut candidates'.

2026-05-18: Fernwood has not answered the 14:00 Tue 19 May proposal; assistant to hold 14:00 tentatively and nudge in morning. Weather: Sat 16 May 7am forecast was 11C, 20% rain; actual 0.2 mm, so Riya was right vs Sam about bailing on the farmers market. Draft thank-you to payouts team for beta passing 10,000 payouts, to be posted by Riya next day.

2026-05-19: New rule from Riya Malhotra: assistant may send routine scheduling replies (accept, propose, confirm times) directly without showing her; any other email still needs her to approve the draft first. Saved in note 'Email rules'.

2026-05-19: Notes 'Mumbai trip 2027': Riya plans to fly alone to Mumbai about ten days in late March 2027 to see her mother Anjali; Sam and Leo stay home, Hannah backup for Wednesday pickup; wants to be there for Mom's medical check-up; look at fares from October, book by December. Fare baseline late March economy: about $1,412-$1,684 CAD one stop; Air Canada direct not on sale yet (opens ~330 days out). Offered a fare alert and October re-check (unanswered).
